documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited presented its financial and operational performance update for Q2 and H1 FY27. Revenue from operations reached ₹2,390.7 crore in Q2 FY27, up 61.0% year-on-year, while H1 FY27 revenue reached ₹4,403.5 crore. The company acquired a 100% stake in Purvi Gems for ₹9 crore to expand its presence in lightweight uncut and precia jewellery. Additionally, management announced that starting FY27, promoters will not draw salaries and all promoter payouts will be executed solely through dividends. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 78% year-on-year to INR2,013 crores and operating PAT crossing INR100 crores.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold surpassed its original FY27 revenue target of ₹5,000 crore a year early.
guidance.quote: Original FY27 revenue target of ₹5,000 Cr surpassed a year early

guidance.claim: The company remains firmly on track to achieve its FY27 revenue aspiration of INR8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Management plans to analyze one more quarter and revise revenue targets post Diwali.
guidance.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to approximately INR 8,100 crore.
The company expects EBITDA margin to be in the range of ~7.0-7.5% in FY27.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: Sky Gold guided for PAT margin at 4.5% - 4.75% for FY27.
The company projects long-term revenue to reach ~INR 18,000 - 19,000 crore by FY30.
Sky Gold guides for a 10-20 bps Y-o-Y improvement in PAT margins.
guidance.quote: However, we guide for 10-20 bps improvement in PAT margins Y-o-Y as we continue investing in new geographies and high-growth categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Natural diamonds currently contribute approximately 2% of the overall business, presenting headroom for future growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Further, natural diamonds currently contribute approximately 2% of our overall business, presenting significant headroom for future growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in the Asiana U.K. India Jewellery Expo built a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry increased from 10.5% in Q4 FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shifts in customer preference.
demand_outlook.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

demand_outlook.claim: The share of studded jewelry increased from 1.65% in Q4 FY26 to 2.1% in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The share of studded jewelry has also increased from 1.65% in Q4 '26 to 2.1% in Q1 '27, on account of management's focus on better-margin products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,50,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold opened an office in Dubai as part of its growth initiatives.
Management stated that capacity utilization is close to 55%-57% and good till 2028 before needing a new facility on a leased model.
capex_expansion.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028. And post that, we may look at a new facility, but that we will continue on the leased model, and capex will not be very big.

capex_expansion.claim: Future facility capex will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, representing 20% to 25% of the PAT generated at that time.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

margins_costs.claim: An increased share of value-added business served as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 from 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Operating PAT crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, representing 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization is currently at approximately 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, again, we are at 60% utilization right now, and we have room of 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total production capacity stands at 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Starting FY27, promoters will not draw salaries and all promoter payouts will be made solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: Beginning FY27, promoters will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model linked entirely to dividends declared from operating cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model. Going forward, promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends, and dividends will be declared only from operating cash flow generated by the business.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for the quarter stood at INR540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The completion timeline for the land sale was extended due to transaction size.
Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will discontinue drawing salaries starting in FY27, receiving all payouts solely through dividends from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Completion of the land sale transaction has been extended beyond August 2026.
The company aims to increase the contribution of natural diamonds and expand presence in lab-grown diamonds over the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The company aims to increase this contribution over the coming years while simultaneously expanding its presence in the rapidly growing lab-grown diamond segment, backed by strong long-term demand trends and continued focus on both natural and lab-grown diamond is expected to strengthen the company's position in the diamond jewelry market and drive sustainable revenue growth and margins.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model where remuneration is linked entirely to dividends from operating cash flow.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model. Going forward, promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends, and dividends will be declared only from operating cash flow generated by the business.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold projects its revised FY27 revenue at ~INR 8,100 crore.
Sky Gold expects EBITDA margin to be in the range of ~7.0-7.5% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
